description.narrative: (Tanzania): With FY2022 funds, USAID will improve the health status of Tanzanians by increasing access to vital health commodities through a total market approach (TMA). Focusing primarily on FP and HIV, this activity will support a local social marketing entity, TMARC, to increase uptake of preventive health services and products in support of GOT and U.S. government health priorities. This activity will support TMARC to develop a pricing and product strategy that takes into account long-term sustainability and social enterprise objectives.. For certain products for which the market is not yet mature, the activity will strive to promote market access, while a focus on the creation of a sustainable brand may be more appropriate for other products already able to generate a steady source of revenue. Additionally, USAID will participate in GOT forecasting and quantification exercises for health products and promote the implementation of a TMA in the country. These efforts directly support the U.S. government's objectives of improving the health status of Tanzanians and support Tanzania to become more self-reliant by maximizing its own private- and public-sector resources. The activity will introduce the use of customized mobile applications to improve sales efficiency and monitoring of products.
